## Results: per-fix test weight, the #25911 pilot, and the verdict (Ask 1, 2, 3)

Read at 2026-11-02T16:37Z on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `94d3e2543` (the `origin/main` tip, committed 2026-11-02T16:10:12Z). Window: first-parent commits on that tip since 2026-10-26T15:20:00Z. That is 1,656 commits, all squash (0 merges). The history is proven present by `node scripts/pm/git-history.mjs ensure --since=2026-10-20` (floor 2026-10-17, no fetch needed). Measurement only: no file, PR or label was written.

### 0. The card's table, re-measured

Same path regexes as the card, with the test class taking precedence over generated, over `packages/` and `ui/`:

| class | added | removed | net |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| test | 359,185 | 43,250 | +315,935 |
| source (card's definition) | 256,853 | 142,879 | +113,974 |
| generated, JSON, fixtures | 8,131 | 3,789 | +4,342 |

The removed column matches the card exactly. The added column is 2 % (test) and 9 % (source) higher. I did not chase this; the tip moved after the card was read.

**The classification moves the multiplier but not the conclusion.** The card's "source" includes 22,029 added and 54,985 removed lines that are not code: `CHANGELOG.md` +16,484 (written by the release tooling), `.mdx` −23,284, `.md` −21,705, `LICENSE` +3,051, and `.sh`. With source limited to code files (`.ts .tsx .js .jsx .mjs .mts .cjs .cts`) it is +234,824 / −87,894 / **net +146,930**. Test against source is then **2.15×** on net lines (the card says 2.5×; the raw table gives 2.77×) and **1.53×** on added lines. Tests still outgrow source by about 2 to 1.

### 1. Per-fix test weight (Ask 1)

Population: the **816** first-parent commits in the window whose subject starts `fix(` (2 more start `fix:` or `fix!` and are not counted). Each file is classified as: test (card regex), generated (card regex), prose (`.md`, `.mdx`, `.txt`, `LICENSE*`, which includes `.changeset/`), or source (everything else, any path). Source lines changed = added + removed.

| reading | median | p90 | other |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| test lines added ÷ source lines changed (809 fixes with source over 0) | **2.28** | **7.47** | p75 4.07, mean 3.59; aggregate 189,425 ÷ 99,540 = 1.90 |
| test lines added per fix | 196 | 476 | total 189,425 |
| source lines changed per fix | 78 | 266 | total 99,540 |
| new test files per fix | **1** | **2** | 876 files over 816 fixes, mean 1.07 |

- 7 fixes change no source line, and 2 of those add tests. Counting them as infinite moves the median to 2.30.
- 83.4 % of fixes add more test lines than the source lines they change.
- 69.7 % of fixes add at least one new test file. **78.8 % of fix test lines (149,189) land in new files** rather than in existing ones.
- `fix(` commits wrote 52.5 % of every test line added in the window (189,425 of 360,886, repo-wide).
- p90 is nearest-rank. The card's example (#29299: 20 source lines, a 191-line test file) is a typical fix, not an outlier.

### 2. The pilot (Ask 2)

**Instruments and their radius**

- (a) **CI before**: `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json`. This is the per-file vitest module diagnostic (environment + prepare + setup + import + run) from CI, median of 6 full-battery runs on 2026-10-19T06:37:09Z, keyed by `pathKey()` (sha1 of the ui-relative path, first 16 hex). To check the keying: `cli-bin.test.ts` reads 74.12 s, which is the 74.1 s #26333 cites.
- (b) **Local before and after**: the authors' own A/B in the bodies of PR #26255 and PR #26309. Same instrument (module diagnostics), same box, same command (`vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface --maxWorkers=2`), shared-box seconds. I did not re-run it, because this dispatch is a no-build container.
- (c) **CI after: NOT MEASURED.** The per-file timings reporter was not ported when `ui/` was imported (see the comment above `Run the ui tests` in `ci.yml`), and the dataset has not been refreshed since 2026-10-19T06:37:09Z. No CI per-file reading exists after the fold.

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| the ten folded pins, CI (a) | 10 files, 70.5 s | not measured |
| the ten folded pins, local (b) | 10 files, 76.6 s CPU (38.1 + 38.5) | 1 file, 13.8 s CPU (**−82 %**) |
| `StudioDesignSurface.*` family, local (b) | 95 files, 1,022.1 s CPU, 528.4 s wall | 86 files, 954.9 s CPU, 493.8 s wall (**−6.6 % CPU, −6.5 % wall**) |

The CI before (70.5 s) and the local before (76.6 s) agree within 9 %, so the local scale holds. Each folded file saved about 6.5 s of fixed cost, and the folded file's own fixed cost stayed about 7.5 s.

**No pin lost (my own check, from git only).** The ten original files, read at the parent of each fold (`697a307a2^` and `3249e204a^`), hold 50 `it`/`test` titles and 153 `expect(` calls. `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx` at `3249e204a` holds the same 50 titles as an identical set, and 153 `expect(` calls. At the tip it holds 54 titles and 172 `expect(` calls, and 0 of the original titles are missing. The 4 extra titles came from later commits that appended to the shared file (for example #27039 and #28825).

**The cli-bin split (#26333) is a split, not a fold.** The heaviest file went from 87.2 s to 57.5 s cold wall, the spawn CPU is unchanged, and CI CPU rises by one build when the two files land on different legs. It is not evidence for or against the shared-setup merge.

**Inflow after the pilot.** `StudioDesignSurface.*` test files: 95 before, 86 after #26309, **116 at the tip**. That is 30 new per-issue pin files in the 7 days since, and 0 deleted. At about 6.5 s of fixed cost each, that is roughly 195 s, about 3× the 67 s the fold saved.

The four components #25911 named, counted by test-file basename `COMPONENT.*.test.ts(x)`:

| family | files at `f143cd88` (pilot base) | files at tip | CI module time at 2026-10-19 (a) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `StudioDesignSurface` | 95 | 116 | 948.0 s |
| `ListView` | 110 | 128 | 615.7 s |
| `ObjectView` | 131 | 141 | 804.8 s |
| `RecordDetailView` | 70 | 99 | 402.0 s |
| `ObjectGantt` | 53 | 56 | 274.3 s |

### 3. Verdict (Ask 3): roll out, and land new pins in the shared file

**Roll out.** The pilot cut its ten pins from 76.6 s to 13.8 s of CPU (the family by 6.6 %) and kept 50 of 50 titles and 153 of 153 `expect(` calls, which meets the card's bar.

**Folding alone does not keep up with the inflow.** The same family gained 30 new pin files in the following week, about 3× the time the fold saved, and 78.8 % of fix test lines go into new files. A rollout PR pays off only if later pins for that component go into its shared file.

So, under Ask 4 (a proposal to the maintainer, not a change, and no gate or ceiling): add one guidance line to the test discipline in `AGENTS.md`: *"A new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes in as a top-level `describe` in that file, not as a new file."* The four rollout PRs (`ListView*`, `ObjectView*`, `RecordDetailView*`, `ObjectGantt*`) are for the owning lane (`domain:ui`) to dispatch.

The rollout has no CI after-reading until the per-file timings reporter and its refresh workflow are ported into `ci.yml`. Today each rollout PR can only cite a local A/B like #26309's.

```
# new files per commit
git log 94d3e2543 --first-parent --since="$SINCE" --diff-filter=A --name-only --format='@@%H'
# test regex:  \.test\.|\.spec\.|__tests__|/test/|/tests/|e2e
# gen regex:   generated|\.snap|\.json|baseline|fixture   (test wins on overlap)

# pilot, pins kept: git show REV:PATH for the 10 originals at 697a307a2^ / 3249e204a^ and the folded file at 3249e204a / 94d3e2543,
#   counting it/test titles and expect( calls
# inflow: git ls-tree -r --name-only REV ui/ | basename COMPONENT.*.test.ts(x), at f143cd88, 3249e204a, 94d3e2543
git log 3249e204a..94d3e2543 --first-parent --diff-filter=A --name-only --format= -- 'ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx'
```

## Collected and accepted · measurement dispatch (claim 6582445213) · 2026-11-02T16:41Z

- **Verdict: ACCEPT.** Results 6582607393 and report 6582630893 are on this card, both through the relay, read back. No PR, no file edit, `mcp_calls` 0: the dispatch's shape held.
- **Seat spot checks, own instrument:** `fix(` first-parent subjects on `origin/main` 2026-10-26T15:20Z → 2026-11-02 15:20 UTC = 811 (the dev's 816 runs to the 16:10Z tip); net test lines ÷ net code-source lines (`.ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx`, generated and fixtures excluded) over `packages` + `ui` = 313,791 ÷ 145,358 = **2.16** (the dev: 2.15). The body's "2.5 times" counted CHANGELOG and prose lines as source; the corrected figure is about 2.15. The conclusion stands.
- **Item 3 verdict: roll out** the shared-setup fold to `ListView*`, `ObjectView*`, `RecordDetailView*`, `ObjectGantt*` (pilot: the ten folded pins 76.6 s → 13.8 s CPU, local A/B; no title or `expect(` lost). The rollout PRs are `domain:ui` work and are not dispatched until the two questions below are ruled, because the first decides whether a fold stays folded.

## Two questions for the maintainer (the dev's `open_questions`, analysed by this seat)

**Q1 — a test-discipline line in `AGENTS.md`:** 「a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes in as a top-level `describe` in that file, not as a new file.」 Reading behind it: `StudioDesignSurface.*` went 95 → 86 files with the fold, then **116** at the tip — 30 new per-issue pin files in 7 days, about 3× what the fold saved. 78.8 % of fix test lines land in new files.
- **A** add the line (one docs PR, governed text, your approval). **B** roll out without it.

**Q2 — the `ui/` per-file timings reporter**, not ported when `ui/` was imported: `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` has been frozen since 2026-10-19, so neither the pilot nor a rollout can be read in CI, and Test UI shard balancing runs on week-old data.
- **A** file one `domain:devx` card to port the reporter and its refresh into `ci.yml` (Tier H, your approval) before the rollout. **B** each rollout PR cites a local A/B as #26309 did.

### 四轴分析

- **项目长远合理性**:Q1 选 A。按组件共用一个测试文件、用 describe 分块,是 Jest/Vitest 生态的常规组织;不加这条规则,合并一次、一周又长回来,实测已是 3 倍。Q2 选 A。CI 自己测出的逐文件耗时,才是分片均衡和测试瘦身的长期依据;本地 A/B 每次换机器、换口径。
- **实际业务拉动**:有。修复 PR 中位数每改 1 行源码配 2.28 行测试,七成修复新开测试文件;Test Core 现在 12–21 分钟,增长会把它推回去。
- **防 AI 犯错**:Q1 是给 AI 读的约定,告诉它新 pin 写进哪里,AI 最常见的做法正是「每张卡一个新文件」。这类约定不属于「声明即强制」的范围,不需要门禁。Q2 不直接防错,但让回归可见。
- **创业阶段不扩散**:Q1 只加一行规则文字,不加门禁。Q2 恢复一个导入时丢掉的测量工具,不是新增门禁;代价是一次 workflow 改动和您一次批准。
